BiblicalUsage: Klope is theft. Matthew 15:19 says thefts proceed out of the heart, and Mark 7:21 says the same: from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, thefts.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jesus puts theft in the heart before it reaches the hand: the hand only takes what the heart has already claimed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
